description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rawathawatta, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520201
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and encumbrances) in various villages and divisions. The content focuses on land ownership, property rights, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
